supplementaryIdentity.rule: Decoded values contain actual U+1F642, never an ASCII escape spelling. Each occurrence occupies one Unicode scalar and two UTF16 units.

raceSchedules.rule: Each P10/P11/P12 repetition selects this numbered deterministic barrier schedule, not a probabilistic rerun.

negativeFamilies.name: reference artifact/source/OS
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Reference row engine/platform, executable/archive/source digests and native OS identity equal selected pins; exactly all16 reference IDs present.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Reference row engine/platform, executable/archive/source digests and native OS identity equal selected pins; exactly all16 reference IDs present.

negativeFamilies.name: product artifact/class/module
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Every product row binds same final JAR and independently frozen complete class/entry/module inventory; internal package not exported/opened.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Every product row binds same final JAR and independently frozen complete class/entry/module inventory; internal package not exported/opened.

negativeFamilies.name: source/staged/output inventory
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Exact expected source and staged names; canonical LF source hashes equal staged/compiler input hashes; output classes bind those sources and selected tools.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Exact expected source and staged names; canonical LF source hashes equal staged/compiler input hashes; output classes bind those sources and selected tools.

negativeFamilies.name: reader dependency closure
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: All fixed reader dependency paths/digests present and executing closure equals bound closure, including inherited reader dependencies.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: All fixed reader dependency paths/digests present and executing closure equals bound closure, including inherited reader dependencies.

negativeFamilies.name: base proof/current controls scope
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Old154 controls bind old artifact/base proof/reader only; new60 controls bind current reader and exact noncyclic scope digest of current final-artifact base.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Old154 controls bind old artifact/base proof/reader only; new60 controls bind current reader and exact noncyclic scope digest of current final-artifact base.

negativeFamilies.name: case/repetition inventory
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Exactly48 scenario definitions and102 rows with exact IDs/repetition numbers/reference mapping; no duplicates, omissions or extra success rows.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Exactly48 scenario definitions and102 rows with exact IDs/repetition numbers/reference mapping; no duplicates, omissions or extra success rows.

negativeFamilies.name: argv/codepoint identity
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Actual child token sequence including empty tokens equals fixture Unicode scalar sequence and UTF16 counts; shell metacharacters cause no effect; javac path result matches.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Actual child token sequence including empty tokens equals fixture Unicode scalar sequence and UTF16 counts; shell metacharacters cause no effect; javac path result matches.

negativeFamilies.name: cwd/environment
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Actual cwd and child set/remove/case probes match request and OS; independent before/after parent env/cwd/console snapshots equal.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Actual cwd and child set/remove/case probes match request and OS; independent before/after parent env/cwd/console snapshots equal.

negativeFamilies.name: launch slot/direct handle binding
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Every admitted launch slot resolves exactly once to failed start or retained direct handle; no Process lost across cancel/start/close; terminal owner has no in-flight slot.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Every admitted launch slot resolves exactly once to failed start or retained direct handle; no Process lost across cancel/start/close; terminal owner has no in-flight slot.

negativeFamilies.name: cancel/force/observed exit
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Every launched owned handle has actual exit observation after graceful/force action as required; canceled wait and PID absence are not exit proof.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Every launched owned handle has actual exit observation after graceful/force action as required; canceled wait and PID absence are not exit proof.

negativeFamilies.name: drainer/stdin terminal
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Stdin and both drain workers have terminal/join observations and resources closed; injected failures remain non-success.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Stdin and both drain workers have terminal/join observations and resources closed; injected failures remain non-success.

negativeFamilies.name: deadline/resource caps
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Monotonic execution+cleanup <= operation cap; grace <=1s cleanup <=5s within deadline; declared JVM/container/floor caps observed unchanged.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Monotonic execution+cleanup <= operation cap; grace <=1s cleanup <=5s within deadline; declared JVM/container/floor caps observed unchanged.

negativeFamilies.name: streams/exit routing
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Raw stdout/stderr separate hash-bound bytes; actual child exit0/17 retained; no timeout, failed capture, cleanup failure or nonzero child represented as successful execution.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Raw stdout/stderr separate hash-bound bytes; actual child exit0/17 retained; no timeout, failed capture, cleanup failure or nonzero child represented as successful execution.

negativeFamilies.name: diagnostic secret redaction
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Tagged synthetic argv/env/stdin/cause/split-chunk sentinels absent every SDK-owned diagnostic byte sequence; raw child/JDK/OS observations classified separately.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Tagged synthetic argv/env/stdin/cause/split-chunk sentinels absent every SDK-owned diagnostic byte sequence; raw child/JDK/OS observations classified separately.

negativeFamilies.name: source preservation
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Complete before/after source inventories equal, independently of prior SDK and sibling observations.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Complete before/after source inventories equal, independently of prior SDK and sibling observations.

negativeFamilies.name: prior SDK preservation
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Prior reusable SDK inventory unchanged and prior SDK executable smoke result retained after canceled/failed staging.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Prior reusable SDK inventory unchanged and prior SDK executable smoke result retained after canceled/failed staging.

negativeFamilies.name: sibling preservation
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Every fixed unrelated sibling sentinel path/hash unchanged and unrelated sentinel process unaffected.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Every fixed unrelated sibling sentinel path/hash unchanged and unrelated sentinel process unaffected.

negativeFamilies.name: filesystem effects/output bindings
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Exact before/after effects and output hashes bind row request and operation; failed/canceled operation never publishes success marker or replaces prior output.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Exact before/after effects and output hashes bind row request and operation; failed/canceled operation never publishes success marker or replaces prior output.

negativeFamilies.name: network/container terminal observations
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Linux network none/caps/resources and terminal container absence bound to operation; Windows network isolation remains explicitly unqualified, never inferred from no packets.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Linux network none/caps/resources and terminal container absence bound to operation; Windows network isolation remains explicitly unqualified, never inferred from no packets.

negativeFamilies.name: relocation/no fallback
negativeFamilies.producerRequirement: Pure reader passes relocated complete proof/source/JAR/reader closure without original paths and rejects missing relocated mandatory input even when original exists.
negativeFamilies.readerAssertion: Pure reader passes relocated complete proof/source/JAR/reader closure without original paths and rejects missing relocated mandatory input even when original exists.
